capabilities: Open a note or folder as a graph map via context menu or command palette
Turn frontmatter blocks into typed nodes and wikilinks or rel: entries into labeled edges
Redraw the map automatically when notes are saved
Refocus the map around a clicked node with degree dials (1st/2nd/3rd/X)
Install an agent skill so coding agents can write map markdown
disambiguation: Not a Markdown converter or export tool despite the name; it renders notes as a read-only graph map inside Obsidian.
extras: Not yet in the community directory; manual install from GitHub releases with provenance attestation. A standalone CLI (npx md2hd) renders the same maps in a browser without Obsidian. Maps are rendered locally with no server or telemetry.
intentEvidence: Obsidian's graph view shows you that links exist. md2hd shows you what they mean.
problem: Obsidian's graph view shows only that links exist, without node types, named relationships, or direction, so the meaning of the structure stays in the reader's head.
summary: Graph view plugin that opens notes or folders as a typed map where frontmatter blocks become nodes and wikilinks become labeled directed edges.
